spans.s: अरु अरु, उस्, m. the sun; N. of a plant.

आरु 1. आ-रु, cl. 2. P. -रौति or -रवीति, -रवि-
तुम्, to shout, to cry out; to praise.

आरु 2. आरु, उस्, m. a hog; a crab; the tree
Lagerstrœmia Regina; (उस्), f. a pitcher.

आरू आरू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ, of a tawny colour;
(ऊस्), m. tawny (the colour).
अरुंषिका अरुंषिका, f. scab on the head.

अरुच् अ-रुच्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. having no light,
lightless.

आरुच् आ-रुच्, Caus. -रोचयति, -यितुम्, to
regard as pleasant, to choose.

अरुचि अ-रुचि, इस्, f. aversion, dislike; want
of appetite, disrelish, disgust.
अ-रुच्य, अस्, आ, अम्, disagreeable, disgusting.
अ-रुच्य, अस्, आ, अम्, disagreeable.

अरुज् अ-रुज्, क्, क्, क्, not breaking, not sup-
purating, not festering; free from disease, sound,
healthy.
आरुज् आ-रुज्, क्, क्, क् (rt. रुज्), breaking.
अ-रुग्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, not broken, not diseased.

आ-रुज, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. breaking, destroying; (अस्),
m., N. of a Rakṣas attendant on Rāvaṇa.

अरुण अरुण, अस्, आ or ई, अम् (said to be fr.
rt. ऋ), reddish-brown, tawny, red; ruddy; the colour of
the morning opposed to the darkness of night; per-
plexed; dumb; (अस्), m. red colour, the colour of the
dawn; dawn; the dawn personified as the charioteer
of the sun; the sun; a kind of leprosy, with red
spots and insensibility of the skin; a little poisonous
animal; N. of a plant, Rottleria Tinctoria; molasses;
N. of several persons; (आ), f., N. of several plants; a
plant Betula; madder, Rubia Manjith; another plant,
commonly Téori; a black kind of the same; Colo-
cynth or bitter apple; the plant that yields the red
and black berry used for the jewellers’ weight,
called Retti; N. of a river; (ई), f. a red cow;
the dawn; (अम्), n. red colour; gold.
—अरुण-
कमल, अम्, n. the red lotus.
—अरुण-ज्योतिस्, इस्
m. an epithet of Śiva.
—अरुण-ता, f. red colour.
—अरुण-दत्त, अस्, m., N. of an author.
—अरुण-
दूर्वा, f. reddish fennel.
—अरुण-प्रिया, f., N. of
an Apsaras.
—अरुण-प्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. having a
red shape.
—अरुण-बभ्रु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. red-
dish-yellow.
—अरुण-युज्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. furnished
with red (rays of light), an epithet of the dawn.
—अरुण-लोचन, अस्, आ, अम्, red-eyed; (अस्), m.
a pigeon.
—अरुण-सारथि, इस्, m. whose charioteer
is Aruṇa; epithet of the sun.
—अरुणाग्र-ज (˚ण-
अग्˚), अस्, m. Garuḍa, the bird of Viṣṇu.
—अरुणात्-
मज (˚ण-आत्˚), अस्, m., N. of Jaṭāyu, a fabulous
bird, said by some to be the son of Aruṇa, but more
generally of Garuḍa.
—अरुणार्चिस् (˚ण-अर्˚), इस्, m.
the sun.
—अरुणावर-ज (˚ण-अव्˚), अस्, m. the
younger brother of Aruṇa, a N. of Garuḍa.
—अरु-
णाश्व (˚ण-अश्˚), अस्, m., Ved. driving with red
horses, an epithet of the Maruts.
—अरुणेक्षण
(˚ण-ईक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, red-eyed.
—अरुणोद (˚ण-
उद्˚), अस्, अम्, m. n., N. of a lake.
—अरुणोदय
(˚ण-उद्˚), अस्, m. break of day, dawn, the period
preceding sunset.
—अरुणोपल (˚ण-उप्˚), अस्, m.
a ruby.

अरुणित, अस्, आ, अम्, reddened, dyed red, im-
purpled.
अरुणिमन्, आ, m. redness, ruddiness.

अरुणी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, reddened, turned or be-
come red.

अरुणीय or अरुणीय-योग, अस्, m. the twenty-fifth
Upaniṣad of the Atharva-veda.

अरुतहनु अ-रुत-हनु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. whose
cheeks or jaws cannot be broken.

अरुद्ध अ-रुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, (rt. रुध्), not
obstructed, not hindered.

अरुन्तुद अरुन्-तुद, अस्, आ, अम्, inflicting
wounds, causing torments; sharp, corrosive; acri-
monious, sour (as disposition).
—अरुन्तुद-त्व, अम्,
n. infliction of pain; acrimoniousness, causticity.

अरुन्धती अ-रुन्धती, f. (rt. रुध्), a medi-
[]
cinal climbing plant; the wife of Vasiṣṭha; the wife
of Dharma; the morning star, personified as the wife
of Vasiṣṭha or of the seven Ṛṣis; also one of the
Pleiades. At marriage ceremonies Arundhatī is in-
voked as a pattern of conjugal excellence by the bride-
groom.
—अरुन्धती-जानि, इस्, or अरुन्धती-नाथ,
अस्, m. Vasiṣṭha, one of the seven Ṛṣis or saints,
and stars in the great bear.

अरुर्मघ अरुर्-मघ, अस्, m., Ved., N. of
certain miserly evil spirits (as the Paṇis, &c.).

अरुशहन् अरुश-हन्, आ, m. (अरुश = अरु-
ष?), Ved. striking the red (clouds), an epithet of
Indra.

अरुष् अ-रुष्, ट्, ट्, ट्, not angry, good-
tempered.

अरुस् अरुस्, उस्, उस्, उस् (fr. rt. ऋ), wounded,
sore; (उस्), n. a sore or wounded; ind. a joint.
—अरुष्-
कर, अस्, आ, अम्, causing wounds, wounding; (अस्),
m. the plant Semecarpus Anacardium; the nut of
this tree.
—अरुष्-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, wounded.
—अ-
रुः-स्राण, अम्, n., Ved. a kind of medical prepara-
tion for wounds.
अ-रुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, not angry, calm.

अरुष अरुष, अस्, ई, अम् (said to be fr. rt.
ऋ and connected with अरुण), Ved. red, reddish; the
colour of Agni and his horses; (अस्), m. the red horse of
Agni, flame; the sun, the day; the red storm-cloud;
(ई), f. the dawn; a red horse; flame; N. of the wife
of Bhṛgu and the mother of Aurva.
—अरुष-स्तूप,
अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having brilliant masses of flame.

अरुष or अरुष्य, nom. P. अरुषति or अरु-
ष्यति, -षितुम्, -यितुम्, to go.

अरूष अरूष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. ऋ), the sun, a
kind of snake.

अरुष्क, अस्, m., N. of a tree, Semecarpus Ana-
cardium.
अरुसिका, f. eruptions on the scalp with acute pain (?).
अरू-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, to wound.
अरुहा अ-रुहा, f., N. of a plant.

आ-रुह, अस्, आ, अम्, leaping up, mounting, ascend-
ing; (अस्), m. ascent.

अरूक्ष अ-रूक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. soft.
—अरूक्ष-ता, f., Ved. softness.
अ-रूक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. soft, supple.
अ-रूक्ष्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. soft, tender.

अरूप अ-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, formless, shape-
less; ugly, ill-formed; dissimilar, unlike.
—अरूप-
ता, f. shapelessness, ugliness; dissimilarity.
—अरूप-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, shapeless, ugly.

अ-रूपक, अस्, आ, अम्, without figure or metaphor,
not figurative, literal.
अ-रूपिन्, ई, इणी, इ, shapeless.

आरुक आरुक, अम्, n. a medicinal plant of
cooling properties growing on the Himālaya moun-
tains.
आ-रुजत्नु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. breaking.

आरुणपराजिन् आरुणपराजिन्, ई, m., N. of
an ancient Kalpa work on the ritual of the Brāhmaṇas.

आरुणि आरुणि, इस्, m. (fr. अरुण), N. of
Uddālaka, a renowned Brāhmaṇa teacher, son of Aruṇa
Aupaveśi and father of Śvetaketu; N. of Auddālaki,
i. e. of Śvetaketu; of Suparṇeya, son of Prajāpati;
of Vainateya, son of Vinatā.

आरुणी आरुणी, f., Ved. ‘the red one,’ a N.
given to the horses of the Maruts, which are females.
See अरुण.
आरुणेय, अस्, m. epithet of Śvetaketu.

आरुणिन् आरुणिन्, इनस्, m. pl., N. of a school
derived from Vaiśāmpāyana Āruṇi.

आरुध् आ-रुध्, cl. 7. P. -रुणद्धि, -रोद्धुम्,
to keep off: Caus. -रोधयति, -यितुम्, to obstruct,
impede.

आरुषी आरुषी, f. (fr. अरुष), N. of a
daughter of Manu and mother of Aurva.

आरुष्कर आरुष्-कर, अम्, n. the fruit of
the Semecarpus Anacardium.

आरुह् 1. आ-रुह्, cl. 1. P. -रोहति, -रोढुम्,
to ascend, mount, bestride; to venture upon, under-
take; to attain, gain: Caus. -रोहयति or -रोपयति,
-यितुम्, to cause to mount or ascend, raise; to cause
to grow; to plant; to place, fasten; to attribute.

2. आ-रुह्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. ascending; (क्), f. excrescence,
shoot (of a plant).

आ-रुरुक्षमाण, अस्, आ, अम् (Desid.), wishing to
ascend.

आ-रुरुक्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, desirous to rise or ascend
or advance, &c.
आ-रुह्य, ind. having mounted, having ascended.

आ-रूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, mounted, ascended, risen;
raised up, elevated on high; often used in compounds,
e. g. इन्द्रियारूढ, brought under the cognizance
of the senses, perceived.
—आरूढ-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
mounting, rising.
आ-रूढि, इस्, f. ascent, mounting, ascending.
